combinator.name: chart

declaration.text: comb @chart[leaf: A -> A, join: A -> A, wrap: A -> A, merge: A -> A, zero_slot: A -> A](w: A) -> A = rec memo recurse(span) = if eq(length(span), 0) then zero_slot() else (if eq(length(span), 1) then (if is_int(at(span, 0)) then leaf(at(span, 0)) else zero_slot()) else let positions = split(span) in let initial = if eq(at(span, 0), "(") then (if eq(at(span, length(span) - 1), ")") then merge(zero_slot(), wrap(recurse(slice_word(span, 1, length(span) - 1)))) else zero_slot()) else zero_slot() in rec walk_splits(position, result) = if eq(position, length(positions)) then result else walk_splits(position + 1, merge(result, join(at(span, at(positions, position)), recurse(slice_word(span, 0, at(positions, position))), recurse(slice_word(span, at(positions, position) + 1, length(span)))))) measure length(positions) - position in walk_splits(0, initial)) measure length(span) in recurse(w) L2
